title: When the negative-balance rule is judged
description: Rule 2 does not say whether intermediate states within one command count. Options: judge every row in sequence, or judge only the final state after the whole command.

options.label: Final state after the whole command

title: Exit code for a load header mismatch
description: The sources list invalid file row as exit 3 and unreadable file as exit 1 but do not place a wrong header. Treating it as a rejected file is the narrowest reading.

title: Non-integer transaction id
description: A transaction id argument that is not an integer is unspecified. Options: exit 3 as an invalid input, or exit 4 as absent.

title: Authentication and diagnostics
description: No user model is stated. The ledger is a single-operator local tool with no application-level auth; diagnostics never echo a DSN or credential.
system_choice: No application-level authentication; diagnostics omit DSN and credentials.
